api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Your key from the service's website. The module's README says where to get one.

interval.title: Update Interval (Seconds)
interval.description: Time between updates. Stay within the service's request limits.

show_header.title: Show Header
show_header.description: Show or hide the module's title.

device_url.title: Device at Home
device_url.description: Optional: the address of a device on your home network whose answer is shown, e.g. http://192.168.1.20/status.

token.title: Token
token.description: Optional: lets a phone shortcut or Home Assistant send a value to the module (see its README). Empty: nobody can.

relay_pin.title: Relay GPIO Pin
relay_pin.description: Optional: the GPIO (BCM) number of a relay that a double press on the mirror's button switches. 0: none.
